answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 927 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the oasis. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the cipher queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. The mesa index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Bonded capital sits idle for 2 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
